points.description: States the answer TRUE and justifies it by saying the pipe is one-directional (data flows only one way through the pipe, so the reverse direction is not allowed). Equivalent wording such as 'a pipe is unidirectional' or 'communication is one-way' earns the mark. A bare TRUE with no one-way justification earns no mark.

States the roles of the two ends: fd[1] is used for writing and fd[0] for reading, so data written to fd[1] can be read from fd[0] but not the reverse. Equivalent wording, such as 'read only from fd[0], write only to fd[1]', earns the mark. Saying the ends can be swapped, or that both ends can read and write, earns no mark.
